account.dossierIntro: Heavy equipment manufacturing is the remote-check-in archetype. Caterpillar runs 110 facilities. Waco TX has 70 doors and 90 trailer spots on 66 acres. 10 of 21 audited sites are rail-served. Heavy steel components arrive by rail; finished machines leave by flatbed.
